note: Set A extracts the revision table and title-block fields accurately, with values correctly bound to each revision row and quotes that support them. Set B contains no claims at all, so it captures none of the page content. Since the page is essentially a title block and revision history over a framing isometric drawing, A's administrative claims are correct and complete enough, while B is empty. A is therefore clearly better.
remarks: The page is a structure isometric drawing (S-901, FRAMING ISOMETRICS) whose only extractable text is title-block and revision-history content; the drawing itself carries no readable dimensions or member sizes in the text layer. Set A covers all four revision rows plus lot number, drawn by, checked by and copyright; it omits sheet title/number and contact blocks, which are administrative and neutral. Set B produced nothing at all.
